Regionally deployed, single-tenant managed source code repository hosted on
Google Cloud.

## Overview

Most applications use the `*Client` types in this library:

- `SecureSourceManagerClient`: Access Secure Source Manager instances, resources, and repositories.

## Quickstart

The following example demonstrates using `SecureSourceManagerClient`:

```swift
import Foundation
import GoogleCloudSecureSourceManagerV1
import GoogleCloudLocation
import GoogleIAMV1
import GoogleLongRunning
import GoogleWKT

func sample(projectId: String, locationId: String, ) async throws {
  let client = try GoogleCloudSecureSourceManagerV1.SecureSourceManagerClient()
  let items = client.listInstancesByItems(
    request: ListInstancesRequest()
  .with {
    $0.parent = "projects/\(projectId)/locations/\(locationId)"
  }
)
  for try await item in items {
    print("  \(item)")
  }
}
```

## Installation

Add `swift-google-cloud-securesourcemanager-v1` as a package dependency:

```bash
swift package add-dependency https://github.com/googleapis/swift-google-cloud-securesourcemanager-v1.git --from 0.3.0
```

Then add `GoogleCloudSecureSourceManagerV1` to your target's dependencies:

```bash
swift package add-target-dependency GoogleCloudSecureSourceManagerV1 <target-name> --package swift-google-cloud-securesourcemanager-v1
```
